falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern featured a hard floor at ~4,850; a sustained break below 4,800 invalidates the structural support thesis and proves this is not that bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The referenced August 2024 bottom saw VIX spike to ~38 then immediately collapse; sustained elevated fear contradicts the rapid volatility compression that defined that pattern, invalidating the analog

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield falls below 4.00% and stays there for 3+ consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom occurred with yields stable-to-rising (growth scare resolved); a flight-to-safety bid driving yields sub-4% indicates a different macro regime (recession fear, not soft landing), breaking the pattern match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
